outcome.answer: Several papers compare fine-tuning strategies for legal retrieval embeddings, but they do not assess legal technical documents across diverse domains in one study. LEMUR finds that contrastive legal-domain fine-tuning improves multilingual retrieval, with gains transferring to unseen languages [1]. For Brazilian legal search, legal-only training favors specialized tasks, while mixing legal and general question-answer data gives a more robust balance across retrieval types [2].
